steps.meaning: Each reported party role row on a right is matched to the single application record for the same right type and application number, so analysts can attach source-stated status and dates to each party role.
cautions: Composite key required because application numbers are scoped by ip_right_type; joining on application_number alone could match a different right type.
Assumes application is unique per (ip_right_type, application_number); duplicates in the full right table will cause the join to be refused rather than silently deduplicated.
Party role presence does not imply ownership, entitlement, or current enforceability of the right.
Status and dates are source-stated values, not derived legal conclusions.

steps.meaning: Each party role row is matched to the description record for the same right type and application number, giving a human-readable description of the right alongside the party role.
cautions: Only valid as many_to_one if application_description holds at most one row per (ip_right_type, application_number); the schema includes description_type, so multiple description types per application would break this and the join must be refused.
If multiple description types exist, a description_type filter (e.g. 'description') would be needed, which is a selection not a star join.
Description text is source-stated and may be truncated or absent; it is not a legal scope of the right.

unsupported_requests: Questions about ownership, beneficial entitlement, or current enforceability of a right based on party role.
Questions requiring a representative sample of all IP rights: this is a patent-prefix pilot only.
Questions needing party identity resolution across party_id/ABN beyond what party_activity states.
Questions requiring multiple description types per application (would need a filtered or one-to-many join, not executable as a star join).
Questions about rights whose application_number collides across ip_right_type without the composite key.
Any claim of population-level accuracy or completeness.
